title: Contemporary Mathematics
description: Contemporary Mathematics is designed to meet the scope and sequence requirements for a liberal arts mathematics course. This resource provides stand-alone sections with a focus on showing relevance in the features as well as the examples, exercises, and exposition. Contemporary Mathematics integrates technology applications, projects, and highlights a diverse group of contributors to mathematics, statistics, and related fields. Print copies of this book will be available for the fall 2023 semester. You can sign up to be notified when print copies are available.
